method: ESTIMATE. This session ran two cases, so no clean per-run meter exists. Figures are summed from the session transcript over the requests after the v6-3 prompt arrived (deduped by message id), then the USD is calibrated by the ratio of the ccusage session total to the same transcript sum over the whole session (13.2053/14.2811 = 0.925).
caveat: cache_read is inflated because this run started on a context already carrying case v6-2 and its gold set. A clean single-case run would read far less. Not attributable to THIS run alone, which the RUN CONDITIONS require.
